baselines: Initial full backend run: 731 pass, 23 failures, 1 existing skip. The added scalar projection fields shifted id from first position and broke existing analysis query mocks. Restored id-first order; targeted 29/29 and final full 760/760 applicable tests pass.
Initial browser fixture used dev compilation/HMR in API process, causing artificial transaction deadline/reload failures. Replaced it with built static client.
Fixed observed smooth-scroll/comment-sheet transition selecting a different Reel. Settle navigation and freeze current offset while sheets open; all browser journeys pass.
Survey E2E initially supplied one question; the existing editor correctly required two. Test now exercises actual multiple questions, not a weakened validator.
Known transient PAGE_ACCOUNT_BUSY during Page lifecycle test is asserted by code before bounded retry; no application authorization bypass.
Initial restricted shell test attempt could not connect to loopback (EACCES); reran authorized local tests with required process permissions. Environment failures are not counted as passing tests.
Independent review found seven actionable issues; corrections were checked in a second independent invocation, which reproduced an additional in-progress upload retry issue.

A new browser test failed on the original compiled API for the expected UPLOAD_EXPIRED/PENDING distinction, then passed on the corrected API. Final independent source-extracted checks confirmed one provider session and reproduced two when the correction was removed.
main_session_review: Server/database ownership, canonical visibility, current Page capability, completed-response immutability, private video grants, exact-byte webhook, cleanup races and disabled-feature retention examined.
React media/request/recording cleanup, signed URL lifetime, lazy HLS, player count, paused-sheet frame, mutations vs late refresh, draft/preview state and existing editor identity checked.
Automatic approval review rejected expanding published quiz-key visibility to authors. Rejected change was not applied; published keys remain redacted.

Confirmed independent findings and corrected them; added permanent attachment receipts, lock-then-reread cancellation, current-row update semantics, signed Page previews, route-scoped viewer lifecycle, terminal/pending upload receipts and single camera ownership.
Supplemental validation: absent or duplicate option IDs cannot produce an invalid all-correct quiz.
